system.description: The Path of the Pariah teaches that Terra is beautiful and full of wonder, regardless of one's circumstances. This lightness in both body and spirit can manifest as a presence impossible to detect. Once per Rest, spend 3 Hope to make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, you become Hidden and remain Hidden while moving, even in plain sight, for a number of scenes equal to your Instinct. The effect ends early if you take actions that explicitly reveal your position.
